details: Verified the exact bound paths, byte counts and hashes before source-dependent conclusions.

blockingFindings.finding: The applicable bBuildAllModules value is not established. Its declaration permits XML configuration, and the base constructor applies configuration before the derived target constructor. The dedicated target does not assign this field. The wrapper observes settings identities and preservation but does not establish this effective selector value. Therefore the ordinary SetupPlugins calculation cannot certify complete actual build selection.

The supplied launch artifact calls PreInitPostStartupScreen but omits that implementation and the subsequent startup route that dispatches Default. The available PluginManager consumer processes a supplied phase; it does not establish when the engine supplies Default. Complete actual startup-order assessment therefore remains unresolved.

targetInitialization: The dedicated target selects Editor, V7, Unreal5_8 include order, C++20, WarhammerClient and EnablePlugins=[E04ProfileProof].
The inherited ShouldIgnorePluginDependency implementation returns false; ReadOnlyTargetRules forwards the exact parent and child arguments to Inner.
Traced base construction, annotation-gated INI/XML/CLI assignment, derived construction, target-type overrides, Windows finalization, descriptor-to-UEBuildTarget mapping and subsequent plugin setup.

The INI-configurable bCompileWithPluginSupport does not control default-plugin enumeration for this target because bCompileAgainstEngine is true. The unresolved all-modules selector is retained explicitly in B01.

descriptorAndGraphAssessment.qualification: Source-derived conditional calculation for Win64, Development, Editor and the ordinary SetupPlugins route; not an executed UBT result or closure of B01.
materialDispositions: Rows 1–5 are extension-only descriptors without module or dependency additions. Their parent relationships were assessed separately from enablement roots.
Row 467 PregenContent is beneath row 468 USDPregen. UBT stops descending after finding the parent descriptor; PregenContent is also unreachable from this target's ordinary roots.

LowLevelNetTrace row 321 has HasExplicitPlatforms=true and SupportedTargetPlatforms=[]. Its synthetic default reference is filtered; its module's explicit empty PlatformAllowList also filters compilation. Its inclusion in the conservative runtime list does not prove build or runtime enablement.

The build calculation contains TcpMessaging and UdpMessaging. Native arguments disable them at runtime. No Plugin-reference occurrence from a parent in the conservative runtime list targets any of the six disabled names.

Thirteen repeated module-name pairs occur within their respective owning plugin descriptors, with differing host declarations. Assessed their filters and AddPlugin's module-instance deduplication; they are not duplicate plugin-name/version collisions.

Assessed absent versus explicit empty platform lists, Editor target-platform inclusion, target/configuration/program selectors, optional dependencies, existing-instance handling, explicit descriptor promotion and dependency-driven runtime descriptor requirements.

EnablePlugins/DisablePlugins receipt overrides are distinct from BuildPlugins. BuildPlugins supplies an optional-dependency allowance rather than runtime enablement roots.
The wrapper checks one staged receipt, exact target/platform/configuration/project/launch identities and the expected E04ProfileProof override.
Traced compile-time allowance collection, command-line selection, receipt/project/default selection, marking, mounting and phase consumption. The missing Default-phase caller remains B02.
Verified the explicit startup-environment clearing in the supervisor and child environment against UE-CmdLineArgs insertion before project/plugin selection.

Read the complete wrapper: single-phase authority, predecessors, six supervisor cases, retained failure evidence, process receiptArtifact handling, source/stage/plugin/fixture preservation and nine settings roles.
The Editor exception conclusion is correctly bounded: global Editor exception enablement is inherited by the probe despite its module-local false. No A1G proof follows.

errorsAndRecoveries: Several oversized display batches were truncated. Recovered applicable mandatory source portions using accurate smaller physical ranges, and recovered metadata through complete projections or independently authored descriptor comparisons.

One array-concatenation query emitted four generated field:null/present:false placeholder witnesses. These were query artifacts, not source fields or source JSON null values. Re-read the actual positively named fields using corrected explicit lists.

One graph query had a parser error and executed no data assessment. A subsequent long query's result was not captured. Replaced both with corrected complete in-memory adjacency queries; no conclusion relies on the failed or lost result.
No unresolved EOF or mandatory-source truncation remains. Nonlocal contract scope text omitted by the initial truncated display is not claimed as reviewed peer scope.
